gaps.lead: It isn't necessary to book in advance.
gaps.explanation: 'Don't have to' = it is not necessary.

gaps.lead: The tickets are certain to be expensive this year.
gaps.explanation: be bound to do = be certain to do.

gaps.lead: The number of students is rising.
gaps.sentence: There is ___ the number of students.
gaps.explanation: 'Is rising' becomes the noun: 'an increase in'.

gaps.lead: A long, dry summer caused the famine.
gaps.sentence: The famine ___ a long, dry summer.
gaps.explanation: A causes B = B results from A (note the direction).

gaps.lead: My grandfather had completely forgotten that he phoned me last night.
gaps.sentence: My grandfather didn't ___ phoning me last night.
gaps.explanation: 'Completely forgotten' becomes 'didn't have any recollection of'.

gaps.lead: You'll fail your exam if you don't revise.
gaps.explanation: unless + present simple = if you don't.

gaps.lead: Someone must check this equipment before every flight.
gaps.explanation: must check → must be checked (modal + be + past participle).
